findings: Profile import validates only nonempty categories and presence of Needs Review ID after decoding. It does not reject duplicate IDs, unsafe folderName components, unsupported schema versions or out-of-range confidence. Previous organizer/discovery append folderName without containment checks.
Import reads entire JSON without byte/category/string limits; save writes atomically but no backup/quarantine of invalid data is made.

load silently falls back to bundled/fallback profile on unreadable or malformed personal JSON and attempts saving the bundled profile, potentially replacing a corrupt personal configuration without a diagnostic.

Built-in merge preserves user display/folder/enabled choices and records namespaced removal tombstones, preventing deleted categories/extensions/keywords from being resurrected. This is a useful migration pattern independent of duplicate matching.

Seven source-read tests cover deleted categories, removed extensions, re-addition, field-scoped tombstones, new built-ins, missing Needs Review and round-trip export/import. Unsafe folder paths, duplicates, corrupt profiles and resource limits are not covered there; tests not executed in this batch.
